name: shape-predict
summary: reads one case file and writes the predicted dump to standard output

arguments.name: CASE
arguments.meaning: path of one case file, read as UTF-8 text

arguments.name: extra
arguments.meaning: every argument after the first is ignored

streams.stdout: the dump bytes on exit 0; empty on exit 1 for a refused case and on exit 2; on exit 1 for an unwritable standard output, part of the dump may have been written
streams.stderr: empty on exit 0 (cargo's own progress lines aside, under cargo run); exactly one line on exit 1 for a refused case and on exit 2; on exit 1 for an unwritable standard output, unspecified and not pinned by a test

determinism: the dump on stdout is the same bytes as the library's predicted dump for the same case text

unpinned_paths.stdout: the dump may be partly written
